    Add participant decisions to a cohort

    Source: R/decisions.R
    sdt_add_decisions.Rd

    Simulates the sighting category and therapy concept a participant assigns to each casualty, using the published per-category hit rates. Where the participant is wrong, the miscall is drawn from the neighbouring categories, since confusing red with yellow is far more likely than confusing red with green.

    Usage

    sdt_add_decisions(cohort, hit = NULL, therapy_hit = 0.75, seed = NULL)

    Arguments

    cohort

    A cohort from sdt_cohort() or sdt_synthetic_cohort().

    hit

    Named numeric vector of per-category hit rates. Defaults to the published triage_hit.

    therapy_hit

    Scalar probability that the therapy concept is called correctly.

    seed

    Optional integer seed, applied with withr::local_seed().

    Value

    The cohort with two added columns: called_triage and called_therapy, the participant's calls.

    See also

    sdt_consistency_score() to score the calls against the truth.

    Examples

    co <- sdt_synthetic_cohort(n = 200, seed = 1)
called <- sdt_add_decisions(co, seed = 2)
sdt_consistency_score(called$triage, called$called_triage)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 4
#>   .metric .estimator .estimate     n
#>   <chr>   <chr>          <dbl> <int>
#> 1 kap     multiclass     0.611   200

# Hit rate per true category, against the published targets.
table(called$triage, called$called_triage)
#>         
#>          green red yellow
#>   green     49   9     15
#>   red        6  67      8
#>   yellow     4   9     33
